summary: Filed a useful public issue on runxhq/runx describing a concrete gap found while publishing a skill: runx login --from-gh shells out to `gh auth token` and fails when the gh binary is absent, even though a valid GitHub token is already available via GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN or the git credential helper. The issue includes the exact error, why it matters for agents/CI, and a fallback-order suggestion.
observations: public_url https://github.com/runxhq/runx/issues/485 loads for a stranger and is a useful issue on the runx repository
the issue links to runx (the project under discussion) and was authored from real usage of runx-cli 0.9.1
the described failure was reproduced on this machine and worked around with a gh shim; the suggestion lists concrete token-source fallbacks
no screenshots, no spam, no reciprocal promotion; the artifact is a maintainer-facing improvement suggestion
